expected_realistic_outcome: negative PnL (gas + slippage + IL likely > fees_collected in a 15m window)
rationale: Pool-level fee proxy is based on pool-level fee velocity / TVL, not on actual_position_fee lineage (which is missing)
EV proxy = -$0.0600 for 20U, computed in upstream real_fee_accrual as the difference between expected fee and gas+slippage
A 15m hold window is unlikely to collect enough fees to overcome the round-trip gas cost + the LP's IL exposure
Even a successful 15m hold with WETH staying inside the medium range [-200643, -200243] produces only a few hundredths of a cent in fees; the gas + slippage dominate
A 10U probe CAN lose the full $10 if the position is closed below entry due to IL or if mint reverts and the allowance is partially spent
probe_objective: validate the full round-trip execution path on a real on-chain position (mint → hold → decreaseLiquidity → collect → revoke)
capture tokenId so downstream pipelines can trace the position
capture actual_position_fee lineage data (the missing input for upstream real_fee_accrual)
measure real PnL for a $10 in-range LP position to calibrate the cost model
success criteria = complete round-trip + complete telemetry, NOT profit

components: gas cost: ~$0.01 - $0.02 at current Base gas (0.0148 gwei)
slippage: up to $0.05 in a 10U entry (QuoterV2 estimate)
IL/LVR: 0 to $1 depending on WETH movement during 15m
WETH residual if any: 0 to 0.0025 WETH = $0 to $5 (depending on price drift)

balance_buffer_required.rationale: $10 notional + $2 buffer for slippage/IL; $0.20 gas for safety beyond the live 218,704 gas ≈ $0.0076 estimate

user_must_understand_before_approving: EV is negative; you are paying for telemetry, not making money
10U is not a small amount of money; if it goes to 0 you have lost it
The probe exits in WETH+USDC; if WETH price moves during the 15m, the residual WETH may be worth more or less than the original USDC-equivalent at entry
The pool's actual_position_fee is unknown; the pool-level proxy says the EV is -$0.06 but actual could be better or worse
There is no automatic retry. If the probe fails for any reason (RPC outage, mempool issue, slippage exceed), you need to manually re-approve to retry
There is no live loop. The probe is one-shot. If you want another probe, you need a new approval
The wallet must be one you personally control; do not use a multi-sig, shared wallet, or cold-storage main treasury
There must be no lpbot-live / lpbot-canary / lpbot-paper / other production trading process running on the host during the probe
You should be prepared to monitor the probe for 15-30 minutes and respond to stop conditions

explicitly_disclaimed.no_scaling_recommendation: 10U/20U is a probe; not a recommendation to scale to $100/$1000/...
explicitly_disclaimed.not_strategy_validation: this probe does NOT validate that an LP strategy is profitable on Base; it only validates the execution path
